name: sys:info
description: Prints infos about the current magento system.
help: Prints infos about the current magento system.

key.name: key
key.description: Only output value of named param like "version". Key is case insensitive.

format.name: --format
format.description: Output Format. One of [csv,tsv,json,json_array,jsonl,yaml,markdown,xml]. Aliases: yml,md,ndjson

help.name: --help
help.description: Display help for the given command. When no command is given display help for the <info>list</info> command

verbose.name: --verbose
verbose.description: Increase the verbosity of messages: 1 for normal output, 2 for more verbose output and 3 for debug

no-interaction.name: --no-interaction
no-interaction.description: Do not ask any interactive question

root-dir.name: --root-dir
root-dir.description: Force magento root dir. No auto detection

skip-config.name: --skip-config
skip-config.description: Do not load any custom config.

skip-root-check.name: --skip-root-check
skip-root-check.description: Do not check if n98-magerun runs as root

skip-core-commands.name: --skip-core-commands
skip-core-commands.description: Do not include Magento 2 core commands

skip-magento-compatibility-check.name: --skip-magento-compatibility-check
skip-magento-compatibility-check.description: Do not check for Magento version compatibility

add-module-dir.name: --add-module-dir
add-module-dir.description: Adds an additional module directory path. Use absolute paths or paths relative to the magerun execution.
